{"content": "1|# Service Pages: Productivity, Storage & Communication\n2|\n3|---\n4|\n5|## 1. nextcloud (File Sync & Collaboration)\n6|\n7|### Purpose\n8|Nextcloud is a self-hosted file sync, share, and collaboration platform. Replaces Google Drive/Dropbox with full control over data. Includes calendar, contacts, office, notifications, and more.\n9|\n10|### Default Port\n11|- Container port: `80` (HTTP)\n12|- Typically exposed via Traefik at `cloud.wineandgecko.com` or similar subdomain\n13|- WebDAV: `/remote.php/dav/`\n14|- OCS API: `/ocs/v1.php/` and `/ocs/v2.php/`\n15|\n16|### API Endpoints\n17|\n18|```\n19|# Core OCS API\n20|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities          — Server capabilities (version, features, apps)\n21|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/user                  — Current user info\n22|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/apps                  — Installed apps list\n23|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/status                — Server status\n24|POST   /ocs/v2.php/cloud/users                 — Create user\n25|DELETE /ocs/v2.php/cloud/users/{id}            — Delete user\n26|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/users/{id}            — User info\n27|PUT    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/users/{id}            — Update user\n28|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/groups                — List groups\n29|POST   /ocs/v2.php/cloud/groups                — Create group\n30|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/activity              — Activity feed\n31|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/notifications         — Notifications\n32|GET    /ocs/v2.php/cloud/preview               — File preview\n33|\n34|# File Sharing\n35|POST   /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares           — Create share\n36|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares           — List shares\n37|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares/{id}      — Share info\n38|DELETE /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares/{id}      — Delete share\n39|PUT    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares/{id}      — Update share\n40|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/sharees          — Search users/groups for sharing\n41|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/publicShares     — Public shares\n42|\n43|# Files External (mounts)\n44|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_external/config      — Mount configs\n45|PUT    /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_external/config/{id} — Update config\n46|POST   /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_external/config      — Add config\n47|DELETE /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_external/config/{id} — Remove config\n48|\n49|# Notifications\n50|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/notifications/api/v2/notifications   — List notifications\n51|DELETE /ocs/v2.php/apps/notifications/api/v2/notifications   — Delete all\n52|\n53|# Preview\n54|GET    /ocs/v2.php/core/preview/{width}x{height}/{fileId}    — File preview thumbnail\n55|\n56|# Comments\n57|GET    /ocs/v2.php/apps/comments/files/{fileId}              — File comments\n58|POST   /ocs/v2.php/apps/comments/files/{fileId}              — Add comment\n59|```\n60|\n61|### WebDAV Endpoints\n62|```\n63|GET    /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/       — List directory (PROPFIND)\n64|PUT    /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/{path} — Upload file\n65|DELETE /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/{path} — Delete file\n66|MKCOL  /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/{path} — Create directory\n67|MOVE   /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/{src}  — Move file\n68|COPY   /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/{src}  — Copy file\n69|GET    /remote.php/dav/calendars/{username}/   — CalDAV calendars\n70|GET    /remote.php/dav/addressbooks/{username}/ — CardDAV contacts\n71|```\n72|\n73|### Auth Method\n74|- Basic auth with app password: `Authorization: Basic <base6...d)>`\n75|- OAuth2 bearer token for external apps\n76|- Cookie-based for web UI\n77|- Required header on all OCS calls: `OCS-APIRequest: true`\n78|\n79|### Data Exposed (capabilities response shape)\n80|```json\n81|{\n82|  \"ocs\": {\n83|    \"meta\": { \"status\": \"ok\", \"statuscode\": 100, \"message\": \"OK\" },\n84|    \"data\": {\n85|      \"version\": { \"major\": 28, \"minor\": 0, \"micro\": 2, \"string\": \"28.0.2\", \"edition\": \"\" },\n86|      \"capabilities\": {\n87|        \"core\": {\n88|          \"pollinterval\": 60,\n89|          \"webdav-root\": \"remote.php/webdav\",\n90|          \"status\": { \"installed\": true, \"maintenance\": false, \"needsDbUpgrade\": false, \"version\": \"28.0.2.1\", \"productname\": \"Nextcloud\", \"edition\": \"\" }\n91|        },\n92|        \"files_thumbnails\": { \"supported\": true, \"maxHeight\": 1024, \"maxWidth\": 1024 },\n93|        \"notifications\": { \"ocs-endpoints\": [\"notifications\", \"settings\"] },\n94|        \"comments\": { \"id\", \"actor\", \"created_at\", \"message\", \"link\" },\n95|        \"checksums\": { \"supported\": true, \"upload\": \"ETag\" }\n96|      }\n97|    }\n98|  }\n99|}\n100|```\n101|\n102|### Dashboard Integration Ideas\n103|1. **Storage Dashboard** — Poll `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities` for server status + `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/user` for storage info. Widget: total storage used vs quota. Value: HIGH (core health metric).\n104|2. **Recent Activity** — Poll `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/activity` for latest uploads/shares. Widget: feed of recent file activity. Value: HIGH (shows system is alive).\n105|3. **Shared Links** — Poll `/ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/publicShares`. Widget: list of public links with expiry. Value: MED.\n106|4. **Upload Queue** — Use WebDAV PROPFIND to check pending uploads. Widget: upload progress. Value: LOW.\n107|\n108|---\n109|\n110|## 2. immich (Photo & Video Management)\n111|\n112|### Purpose\n113|Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution for mobile devices. Alternative to Google Photos with face recognition, map view, albums, and AI-powered search.\n114|\n115|### Default Port\n116|- Container port: `2283` (API)\n117|- Typically exposed via Traefik at `photos.wineandgecko.com` or similar\n118|- Web UI: same port, proxied\n119|\n120|### API Endpoints\n121|\n122|```\n123|# Auth\n124|POST   /api/auth/admin-sign-up           — Admin signup (first user only, no auth)\n125|POST   /api/auth/sign-in                 — Login (returns accessToken + refreshToken)\n126|POST   /api/auth/sign-out                — Logout\n127|GET    /api/auth/me                      — Current user info\n128|GET    /api/auth/change-password         — Change password\n129|POST   /api/auth/forgot-password         — Forgot password\n130|POST   /api/auth/verify-email            — Verify email\n131|GET    /api/auth/admin-stats             — Admin-only stats (users, storage, etc.)\n132|\n133|# Assets (photos/videos)\n134|GET    /api/assets                       — List assets (query: albumId, userId, takenBefore, takenAfter, limit, after, before)\n135|GET    /api/assets/{id}                  — Asset details with EXIF\n136|DELETE /api/assets/{id}                  — Delete asset\n137|PUT    /api/assets/{id}/library          — Move asset to library\n138|GET    /api/assets/{id}/thumbnail        — Thumbnail (query: width, height, quality)\n139|GET    /api/assets/{id}/preview          — Preview image\n140|GET    /api/assets/{id}/original         — Original file download\n141|GET    /api/assets/{id}/info             — EXIF info\n142|GET    /api/assets/by-date/{date}        — Assets by date (YYYY-MM-DD)\n143|POST   /api/assets/sync                  — Sync assets (bulk)\n144|GET    /api/assets/random                — Random assets\n145|\n146|# Albums\n147|GET    /api/albums                       — List albums\n148|GET    /api/albums/{id}                  — Album details\n149|POST   /api/albums                       — Create album (body: { name, albumName, assetIds, userIds })\n150|PUT    /api/albums/{id}                  — Update album\n151|DELETE /api/albums/{id}                  — Delete album\n152|POST   /api/albums/{id}/users            — Add user to album\n153|DELETE /api/albums/{id}/users/{userId}   — Remove user\n154|POST   /api/albums/{id}/assets           — Add asset to album\n155|DELETE /api/albums/{id}/assets/{assetId} — Remove asset\n156|\n157|# Users (admin)\n158|GET    /api/users                        — List users\n159|GET    /api/users/{id}                   — User details\n160|PUT    /api/users/{id}                   — Update user\n161|DELETE /api/users/{id}                   — Delete user\n162|\n163|# Faces\n164|GET    /api/faces                        — List faces\n165|GET    /api/faces/{id}                   — Face details\n166|PUT    /api/faces/{id}                   — Name face\n167|GET    /api/faces/{id}/assets            — Assets with this face\n168|\n169|# Library\n170|GET    /api/library                      — List libraries\n171|POST   /api/library                      — Create library\n172|DELETE /api/library/{id}                 — Delete library\n173|\n174|# Map\n175|GET    /api/map/countries                — Country photo counts\n176|GET    /api/map/regions                  — Region photo counts\n177|GET    /api/map/cities                   — City photo counts\n178|\n179|# Shared Links\n180|GET    /api/shared/link                  — List shared links\n181|DELETE /api/shared/link/{id}             — Delete shared link\n182|\n183|# Search\n184|GET    /api/search/suggestions           — Search suggestions\n185|GET    /api/search/explore               — Explore (auto-albums)\n186|GET    /api/search/explore/{albumId}     — Explore album contents\n187|GET    /api/search/reverse-geocoding     — Reverse geocode (query: latitude, longitude)\n188|\n189|# Timeline\n190|GET    /api/timeline/neighbors           — Timeline neighbors (query: takeBefore, takeAfter)\n191|\n192|# Memory (automated memories like \"on this day\")\n193|GET    /api/memory                       — List memories\n194|POST   /api/memory                       — Create memory\n195|DELETE /api/memory/{id}                  — Delete memory\n196|\n197|# Trash\n198|GET    /api/trash                        — Trash items\n199|POST   /api/trash/empty                  — Empty trash\n200|POST   /api/trash/restore                — Restore from trash\n201|\n202|# Server / Admin\n203|GET    /api/server/info                  — Server info (version, uptime, etc.)\n204|GET    /api/server/storage               — Storage usage breakdown\n205|GET    /api/server/version               — Version string\n206|GET    /api/server/config                — Server config\n207|POST   /api/server/config                — Update config\n208|GET    /api/server/license               — License info\n209|GET    /api/server/statistics            — Stats (photo/video counts, users, storage)\n210|GET    /api/server/telemetry             — Telemetry data\n211|GET    /api/server/media-types           — Supported media types\n212|GET    /api/server/features              — Enabled features\n213|GET    /api/server/backup                — Backup info\n214|POST   /api/server/restore               — Restore from backup\n215|```\n216|\n217|### Auth Method\n218|- API key header: `x-api-key: ***\n219|- Bearer token (from login): `Authorization: Bearer ***\n220|- Admin signup is first user only (no auth needed)\n221|\n222|### Data Exposed (server info response shape)\n223|```json\n224|{\n225|  \"version\": \"1.115.0\",\n226|  \"storage\": { \"usageByType\": { \"photos\": 1234567890, \"videos\": 9876543210, \"others\": 123456 } },\n227|  \"statistics\": { \"photoCount\": 50000, \"videoCount\": 5000, \"usage\": 11111111111 }\n228|}\n229|```\n230|\n231|### Dashboard Integration Ideas\n232|1. **Photo Library Overview** — Poll `/api/server/statistics` for photo/video counts and storage. Widget: total photos, videos, storage used. Value: HIGH (core health metric).\n233|2. **Storage Breakdown** — Poll `/api/server/storage` for usage by type. Widget: pie chart of photo vs video storage. Value: HIGH.\n234|3. **Recent Uploads** — Poll `/api/assets` with `takenAfter` filter. Widget: last N photos uploaded. Value: HIGH.\n235|4. **Server Health** — Poll `/api/server/info` for version and uptime. Widget: version badge + uptime indicator. Value: MED.\n236|5. **Face Recognition Stats** — Poll `/api/faces` for face count. Widget: faces recognized count. Value: LOW.\n237|\n238|---\n239|\n240|## 3. mealie (Recipe Manager)\n241|\n242|### Purpose\n243|Mealie is a self-hosted recipe management app. Create, organize, and share recipes with meal planning, Endpoints\n250|\n251|```\n252|# Auth\n253|POST   /api/auth/token                   — Login (returns JWT token)\n254|POST   /api/auth/register                — Register new user\n255|POST Recipes\n260|GET    /api/recipes                      — List recipes (query: page, page_size, category, tag, ingredient, name, no_image, exclude_category, sort)\n261|GET    /api/recipes/{slug} count total recipes. Value: LOW.\n366|\n367|---\n368|\n369|## 4. booklore (Digital Library)\n370|\n371|### Purpose\n372|BookLore is a self-hosted digital library for organizing, reading, and tracking books. Features smart shelves, auto metadata from Google Books/Open Library/Amazon, Kobo sync, OPDS support, and a built-in reader for EPUB, PDF, and comics.\n373|\n374|### Default Port\n375|- Container port: `6060`\n376|- Healthcheck: `http://localhost:6060/api/v1/healthcheck`\n377|- Typically exposed via Traefik at `books.wineandgecko.com` or similar\n378|- OPDS catalog available at `/opds`\n379|\n380|### API Endpoints\n381|\n382|```\n383|# Health\n384|GET    /api/v1/healthcheck               — Health check (returns {\"status\":\"ok\"})\n385|\n386|# Books\n387|GET    /api/v1/books                     — List books (query: page, per_page, sort, order, search, shelf_id, author_id, format, tag)\n388|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}                — Book details with metadata\n389|POST   /api/v1/books                     — Add book (multipart form)\n390|PUT    /api/v1/books/{id}                — Update book metadata\n391|DELETE /api/v1/books/{id}                — Delete book\n392|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}/cover          — Cover image (auto-resized)\n393|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}/file           — Download book file\n394|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}/progress       — Reading progress\n395|PUT    /api/v1/books/{id}/progress       — Update reading progress\n396|POST   /api/v1/books/{id}/metadata       — Fetch/refresh metadata\n397|POST   /api/v1/books/{id}/send           — Send to Kindle/email\n398|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}/annotations    — Annotations\n399|POST   /api/v1/books/{id}/annotations    — Add annotation\n400|GET    /api/v1/books/{id}/reviews        — Community reviews\n401|\n402|# Shelves\n403|GET    /api/v1/shelves                   — List shelves\n404|GET    /api/v1/shelves/{id}              — Shelf details\n405|POST   /api/v1/shelves                   — Create shelf\n406|PUT    /api/v1/shelves/{id}              — Update shelf\n407|DELETE /api/v1/shelves/{id}              — Delete shelf\n408|POST   /api/v1/shelves/{id}/books        — Add book to shelf\n409|DELETE /api/v1/shelves/{id}/books/{bookId} — Remove book\n410|\n411|# Magic Shelves (dynamic/auto-updating)\n412|GET    /api/v1/magic-shelves             — List magic shelves\n413|POST   /api/v1/magic-shelves             — Create magic shelf\n414|PUT    /api/v1/magic-shelves/{id}        — Update rules\n415|DELETE /api/v1/magic-shelves/{id}        — Delete magic shelf\n416|\n417|# User details\n436|PUT    /api/v1/users/{id}                — Update user\n437|DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}                — Delete user\n438|\n439|# Reading Progress\n440|GET    /api/v1/reading-progress          — List reading progress\n441|PUT    /api/v1/reading-progress/{bookId} — Update progress\n442|GET    /api/v1/reading-progress/stats    — Reading stats\n443|\n444|# Stats\n445|GET    /api/v1/stats                     — Library statistics\n446|GET    /api/v1/stats/reading             — Reading stats\n447|GET    /api/v1/stats/formats             — Format distribution\n448|GET    /api/v1/stats/tags                — Tag distribution\n449|\n450|# OPDS (catalog for e-readers)\n451|GET    /opds                             — OPDS catalog feed\n452|GET    /opds/catalog/{id}                — OPDS catalog entry\n453|GET    /opds/catalog/{id}/{page}         — Paginated OPDS catalog\n454|\n455|# BookDrop (auto-import)\n456|GET    /api/v1/bookdrop                  — BookDrop status\n457|GET    /api/v1/bookdrop/pending          — Pending imports\n458|POST   /api/v1/bookdrop/{id}/import      — Import pending book\n459|POST   /api/v1/bookdrop/{id}/cancel      — Cancel Method\n467|- Local auth (username/password) or OIDC\n468|- Session cookie-based for web UI\n469|- OPDS supports anonymous or basic auth depending on config\n470|- API is undocumented/unversioned — endpoints may change without notice\n471|\n472|### Data Exposed (book response shape)\n473|```json\n474|{\n475|  \"id\": \"uuid\",\n476|  \"title\": \"Book Title\",\n477|  \"authors\": [{ \"id\": \"uuid\", \"name\": \"Author Name\" }],\n478|  \"series\": { \"id\": \"uuid\", \"name\": \"Series Name\", \"position\": 1 },\n479|  \"cover_url\": \"/api/v1/books/{id}/cover\",\n480|  \"formats\": [\"epub\", \"pdf\"],\n481|  \"tags\": [{ \"id\": \"uuid\", \"name\": \"fiction\" }],\n482|  \"description\": \"...\",\n483|  \"rating\": 4.5,\n484|  \"pages\": 350,\n485|  \"language\": \"en\",\n486|
